title: Apps
subtitle: Deploy a Docker image or a Git repo to a server.
volBackupsDesc: Back up this app's named volumes to a destination, on a schedule or on demand.
volExportHint: Generate a temporary download link for this S3 backup to import it on another server.
volExportExpiry: Link expires in 24 hours — paste it into "Import from URL" on the target server.
volImportDesc: Pull a volume's data from a staged tar(.gz) you exported elsewhere (e.g. from an old server) — a migration data-pull.
volImportWarn: This overwrites the target volume — its current contents are wiped before the import.
volImportConfirm: Import into this volume? Its current contents will be wiped and replaced.

files.title: Files
files.noVolumes: This app doesn't declare any persistent volumes.
files.truncated: Showing the first {count} entries — this folder has more.

noMetrics: No metrics yet — they appear a few seconds after the container starts.
deleteConfirm: Delete this app and its container/volumes? This cannot be undone.
deleteConfirmCompose: Delete this compose app? Its containers AND its named volumes (all data) are removed. This cannot be undone — back up volumes first.
keepVolumes: Keep volumes (don't delete this app's data)
removeImages: Also remove this app's built/pulled images (reclaim disk)
overviewHint: Use Deploy to build and start this app. The sections on the left hold environment variables, limits, volumes and more.
readOnlyHint: You have read-only access to this app.
iconHint: A square icon shown across the dashboard. Upload a PNG, JPG or WebP — it is cropped to a square PNG (up to 128px) and stored on your own instance.
iconTooLarge: That image is too detailed to store as an icon. Try a simpler one.
noLogs: No logs yet — deploy this app to see build output here.
name: Name
healthTimingsHint: Seconds; leave blank for the default. Raise start period and retries for a slow-booting app so it isn't rolled back prematurely.
extraPortsDesc: Publish additional host ports (TCP/UDP) beyond the app's main port — e.g. metrics, gRPC or a UDP service. Applies on the next deploy.
basicAuthDesc: Protect this app with a username and password (HTTP Basic Auth). Passwords are hashed and never shown again. Applies on the next deploy.
basicAuthReplaceNote: Saving replaces all users (re-enter every password). Save with no users to remove basic auth.
redirectsDesc: Rewrite incoming requests with regular-expression redirects (e.g. move an old path, or force a canonical host). Each rule becomes a Traefik redirect; the first matching rule wins. Applies on the next deploy.
redirectsHint: Use ${1}, ${2}… to reuse captured groups. Leave Permanent off for a temporary (302) redirect. Saving replaces all rules; save with none to remove them.
previewExcludeEnvHint: One env var name per line. These are dropped from a PR preview's env so production secrets never reach an ephemeral preview.
previewLimitHint: Max concurrent previews (blank = unlimited); a new PR beyond the cap evicts the oldest.
autoDeployHint: When on, a push to the tracked branch deploys automatically. Turn off to pause without removing the webhook.
ipAllowlistDesc: One IP or CIDR per line. When set, only these source ranges may reach the app (checked before any auth). Empty allows all. Applies on the next deploy.
pathPrefixDesc: Serve this app under a URL path, e.g. /api (must start with /). Empty serves at the domain root. Applies on the next deploy.
rateLimitDesc: Limit requests per client IP (average per period, with a burst allowance). Behind a CDN or tunnel all clients share one IP. Applies on the next deploy.
watchPathsDesc: One glob per line (leading ! to exclude). When set, a push only deploys if a changed file matches — so a monorepo doesn't rebuild every app on every push. Empty deploys on every push. Applies to the next push.
composePathHint: Path to the compose file inside the repo (default docker-compose.yml). Cloned, validated and run on deploy.
composeHint: Validated on save; changes apply on the next deploy.

cfgMounts.title: Config files
cfgMounts.hint: Files Tugra mounts read-only into your containers. Only the content can be changed. Avoid pasting secrets — config files are stored unencrypted. Changes apply on the next deploy.
cfgMounts.redeploy: Saved — redeploy to apply the new content.

containerPortHint: The port your app listens on inside the container (default 80). Set it to e.g. 3000 or 8080 so the proxy routes to the right port.
empty: Deploy your first app from a Git repo, image, or compose file.
notDeployedBody: Review this app's environment, ports, volumes and domain, then deploy when you're ready.
cloneHint: Creates a copy on the same server with the same build, environment and settings. The domain, TLS certificate and webhook are not carried over, volumes start empty, scheduled tasks are copied disabled, and the clone isn't deployed — you deploy it when ready.
noBuildOutput: No build output — image pulled and started.
deployHooksDesc: Run a command in a container of this app's image before the swap (e.g. database migrations) and inside the live container after the health check passes. A failing pre-deploy command aborts the deploy with the current version still serving; a post-deploy command is best-effort. Single-server apps only; applies on the next deploy.
deployHooksRedeploy: Saved. Hooks run on the next deployment.
webhookDesc: Add this URL + secret to your repository (GitHub: Settings → Webhooks; GitLab: Settings → Webhooks). A push to {branch} redeploys automatically.
regenerateConfirm: Regenerate the webhook secret? The old one stops working.
envDesc: Stored encrypted. Injected at deploy via an env-file (not the command line).
envDescSwarm: Stored as a Docker secret and decrypted only inside the running container — never written to the cluster's shared config store (needs an image with a shell; distroless images fall back to standard env).
envRedeploy: Saved — redeploy to apply the new values.
envDupWarning: Duplicate keys: {keys}. Rename or remove — only one value per key can be saved.
envInvalidWarning: Not valid env var names: {keys}. Use letters, digits and underscores (must not start with a digit).
dbLinksDesc: Attach a managed database — its connection URL is injected into this app's environment automatically on deploy.
dbLinksAdopt: Replace an app env var of the same name
dbLinksShadowed: overridden by an app env var
dbLinksNoDbs: No eligible database on this app's server. Create one on the same server to link it.
dbLinksRedeploy: Takes effect on the next deploy.
secretRefsDesc: Inject a value from a connected secret store into this app's environment on every deploy. Only the location is stored here, never the value.
secretRefsEnvVarInvalid: Use a POSIX name: a letter or _ then letters, digits or _.
secretRefsLocatorHint: Vault KV v2 path: <mount>/<path>#<field> — e.g. secret/myapp#DB_PASSWORD
secretRefsOverrides: replaces the app env var of the same name
secretRefsNoProviders: No secret store is connected for this team yet.
secretRefsProHint: External secrets are a Pro feature. Activate a license under Settings to bind one.
secretRefsRedeploy: Fetched fresh from the store on every deploy; a secret that can't be fetched fails the deploy.
buildArgsDesc: Injected at image build time (docker build --build-arg / buildpack --env). Visible in image history — don't store true secrets here. Applied on next deploy.
buildArgsRedeploy: Saved — redeploy to apply the new build arguments.
sourceDesc: Change where this app's code or image comes from. Applied on the next deploy. Changing a repo to a different host resets the stored Git credential for safety.
sourceWarn_git_token_cleared: The stored Git access token was cleared because the repository host changed.
sourceWarn_git_source_unlinked: The GitHub App was unlinked because the repository host changed.
sourceWarn_ssh_key_generated: A new SSH deploy key was generated — add its public key to the repository before deploying.
buildSettingsDesc: Change how this Git app is built. Set a base directory to build a subfolder of a monorepo. Switching the pack clears the fields that don't apply to it. Applied on the next deploy.
buildDockerfilePath: Dockerfile path, relative to the base directory (Dockerfile)
buildSaveFailed: Could not update the build settings.
dockerOptionsDesc: Advanced: raw flags appended to docker run (e.g. --cap-add, --sysctl, --dns, --add-host). Wrong flags can break the deploy. Applied on next deploy.
containerCommandDesc: Override the image's ENTRYPOINT and CMD. One argument per line, passed directly with no shell. For shell features set the entrypoint to sh and -c (one per line) and put the script in the command — the image must contain sh. Applied on the next deploy.
noContainers: No containers found (deploy the app first).
containerLogsDesc: Recent stdout/stderr from the running container (last 200 lines).
logsEmpty: No output (container not running or no logs yet).
liveLogsDesc: Live stdout/stderr streamed straight from the running container.
pickContainerToStream: Pick a container to stream its logs.
rollbackConfirm: Roll back to this deployment's image? The app will restart on the old version.
limitsDesc: Optional CPU/memory limits and deploy timeout. Applied on next deploy.
deploySettingsDesc: How a new version replaces the running one on each deploy.
rollbackOnFailure: Auto-rollback on a failed health check
rollbackOnFailureDesc: Off: a failed deploy stays down instead of restoring the previous version.
clusterDeployDesc: Deploy this app as a Docker Swarm service with N replicas spread across a cluster's swarm, instead of one server.
clusterDeployNote: Routed via the cluster's swarm Traefik (custom domain over TLS, or a wildcard DNS-01 magic domain when the manager node is configured with le-dns), or reachable on any node's host port when domainless. The manager node must be dedicated to the swarm (no classic apps on :80/:443). Logs are aggregated across replicas; the terminal opens a shell into one running replica (the node needs the 'terminal' capability); metrics show every task.
clusterNoSwarms: No cluster with a formed swarm in this team. Form a swarm on a cluster first.
clusterSaveFailed: Couldn't update the cluster deploy settings.
clusterCapacityWarn: {replicas} replicas across {online} online node(s) — some nodes will run more than one replica.
clusterPinnedBanner: Pinned to {node} because it has persistent storage.
clusterStatefulHint: This app has persistent storage (named volumes) — deploying it to a cluster hard-pins it to one node and locks replicas to 1.
clusterStatusUnavailable: Live replica status unavailable — the swarm manager may be offline.
clusterSaveToDeploy: Save to deploy to this cluster and see live replicas.
buildConfigDesc: Push the built image to a team registry on each deploy (portable images, multi-server, rollbacks).
buildServerHint: Build on a separate server, then pull the image to deploy (needs a registry).
buildNoRegistries: No registries in this team yet — add one under Container Registries.
healthCmd: Health check command (e.g. curl -fsS http://localhost:80/ || exit 1)
healthCheckDesc: How a new version is verified before it goes live. A failed check auto-rolls-back to the previous version. Applied on next deploy.
placementDesc: Pin or spread this app's replicas across specific nodes. Every option is drawn from the cluster's live nodes.
placementNoLiveNodes: No live nodes to place onto yet — the cluster's manager may be offline.
placementNoLabels: No node labels yet — add some on the cluster page.
placementSaved: Saved — applied on the next deploy.
volumesDesc: Named volumes keep data across redeploys. Applied on next deploy.
hostMountsDesc: Mount a folder from the server into the app — e.g. your media library at /mnt/media for Jellyfin or Plex. Applied on next deploy.
hostMountsHint: System paths (/etc, /var, /home, /srv, the Docker socket, …) are blocked for safety. Read-only is recommended unless the app needs to write.
credentialsDesc: Access a private git repo or container registry. Stored encrypted; applied on next deploy.
gitTokenHint: For a private HTTPS repo on GitHub, GitLab, Gitea or a self-hosted server: paste a personal access token with read access to the repository.
deployKeyHint: Add this public key to the repository as a read-only deploy key (GitHub/GitLab/Gitea → Settings → Deploy keys), then deploy. The private key stays encrypted on the server.
deployKeyNone: This SSH repository needs a deploy key. Generate one, add the public key to the repo, then deploy.
tasksDesc: Run a command inside the container on a cron schedule.
previewDesc: Open a pull request and Tugra deploys a throwaway copy on its own subdomain; close the PR and it's torn down automatically.
previewEnable: Deploy a preview for each pull request
previewNeedsDomain: Add a domain to this app first — previews are served at pr<n>.<domain>.
previewWildcardHint: Point a wildcard DNS record *.{domain} at this server so each preview URL resolves.
previewNone: No active previews. They appear here when a pull request is opened.
exposeNoUrl: Saved, but no reachable URL could be built — this server has no public IP or wildcard domain (or it's a Compose app). Set a host port or a wildcard domain.
exposeApplyNote: Applied to the proxy on the next deploy.
tunnelExposeDesc: Route this app's domain through the server's tunnel so it's reachable from the internet with no public IP.
tunnelExposeNeedsDomain: Give the app a domain first (magic or custom), then it can be routed through the tunnel.
exposeModeDesc_magic: Auto domain from the server's IP — reachable instantly, no DNS setup.
exposeModeDesc_custom: Your own domain, served over HTTPS (Let's Encrypt).
serviceDomainsDesc: Route individual compose services to their own hostnames (each over HTTPS). Give the service name, a hostname pointed at this server, and the service's container port. Up to 20. Applied on the next deploy.
serviceDomainsRedeploy: Saved — redeploy to apply the service domains.
serviceDomainsSaveFailed: Could not update the service domains.
extraDomainsDesc: Additional hostnames served by this app alongside the primary domain, each over HTTPS. Point each at this server, then redeploy. Up to 10.
extraDomainsRedeploy: Saved — redeploy to apply the new domains.
extraDomainsSaveFailed: Could not update the extra domains.
dnsAutoDesc: Point this domain at your server with a Cloudflare API token — apex A (+ www) records, created for you. DNS-only, so there's no proxy redirect loop.
dnsAutoWildcardLink: Need a wildcard (*.example.com) certificate, or one while the record stays Cloudflare-proxied? Set up DNS-01 on this server →
dnsAutoApiTokenHint: Create a token with Zone:DNS Edit and Zone:Zone Read for this domain's zone.
dnsAutoApplied: DNS records created — it can take a few minutes to propagate.
dnsAutoConflictNote: Some records already exist and point elsewhere. Enable overwrite to replace them.
dnsAutoManualToggle: Not using Cloudflare? Set up manually
dnsAutoManualDesc: Create these records at your DNS provider, then save the domain.
domainRedeployNote: Point this hostname at your server, then redeploy to apply.
domainOptionsDesc: Redirect and security headers for this domain. Applied on next deploy.
forwardAuthDesc: Protect this app behind an external auth service (Authelia, oauth2-proxy, Authentik). Every request is verified there first. Leave empty to disable.
customCertDesc: Serve your own TLS certificate for this app's domain instead of Let's Encrypt — paste the certificate chain (PEM) and its private key. The key is encrypted at rest and never shown again. Applied on the next deploy.
certClearConfirm: Remove this custom certificate? Redeploy the app afterwards to finish the switch — until you do, HTTPS serves a temporary self-signed certificate. It then falls back to Let's Encrypt.
certUploaded: Certificate stored — redeploy the app to start serving it.
certCleared: Custom certificate removed — redeploy the app to finish switching off it.
